title: FlowDoc Core Backend Readiness Matrix Checklist

items.label: Capture the Work path, owner repository, active role, Phase, Checklist, and Evidence target before editing.
items.evidenceTarget: The readiness matrix records the current FlowDoc Work context and remains owned by Project Control.
items.verificationNote: The matrix records work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-readiness-matrix, owner repo-project-control, active role cross-repo-boundary-reviewer, phase-flowdoc-core-backend-readiness-matrix, checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-readiness-matrix, and evidence-flowdoc-core-backend-readiness-matrix-2026-08-27.

items.label: Reconcile accepted Core, Backend, Editor, compatibility, and terminology evidence before deciding readiness.
items.evidenceTarget: The matrix cites existing evidence records instead of reinterpreting repository heads without proof.
items.verificationNote: Reviewed accepted evidence for Core default gate stability, Core runtime version contract, Core public export boundary, Backend Core-version consumer hardening, Backend service readiness boundary, Editor live harness, Editor browser smoke, Editor browser corpus smoke, bounded browser compatibility promotion, and product terminology.

items.label: Classify Core readiness into bounded passes, no-go boundaries, risks, and unknowns.
items.evidenceTarget: Core rows distinguish stable owner gates and version inventory from unresolved public consumer surface readiness.
items.verificationNote: The matrix treats Core default gate and runtime version inventory as bounded passes while keeping the broad root export boundary unresolved for future consumer-surface freeze work.

items.label: Classify Backend readiness without confusing local development readiness with production service readiness.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend rows distinguish Core-version consumer wrapping and local development readiness from production blockers.
items.verificationNote: The matrix records Backend Core-version consumer hardening as bounded pass and Backend service readiness as blocked for production until auth, tenancy, storage providers, export mounting, workers, renderer/provider binding, deployment, TLS/proxy, rate limits, telemetry, backup, and rollback are owned.

items.label: State the frontend redesign decision before implementation starts.
items.evidenceTarget: The matrix permits frontend architecture planning and adapter design, but blocks implementation that assumes production Backend readiness.
items.verificationNote: The matrix records GO for architecture planning and contract hardening, plus NO-GO for frontend implementation that assumes production Backend readiness or broad FlowDoc product readiness.

items.label: Register Project Control records and verify the generated read model without truth promotion.
items.evidenceTarget: Work, Phase, Checklist, Document, Evidence, node links, tests, and generated index validate while FlowDoc remains planned and Core, Backend, and Editor remain unknown.
items.verificationNote: This item is satisfied only after the focused readiness matrix test, npm run generate, npm run check:data, focused roadmap/seed tests, and npm run check pass in the worktree and merged main.
